paragraphs: AI: "AI anxiety is real. Here’s how to deal with it, according to therapists." (The Washington Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Creating a Kill Switch to Shut Down a Rogue A.I. Is Harder Than It Sounds" (The New York Times).
Political: "All the many things that happened in 1776" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Learning to love those who misuse the language" (Washington Examiner).
Economic: "Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers" (NPR) leads the coverage. Also notable: "The Fed just ended Washington’s cheap-money era" (Washington Examiner).

Financial: "A Borrower’s Timeline of the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Quagmire" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Europe’s Winter Power Surge Is Biggest Since Energy Crisis" (Bloomberg).

Geopolitical: "Russia Warns New U.S. Sanctions Law Would Harm Trump’s Peace Efforts" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Parents in England and Wales could be fined or jailed for child’s crimes, minister says" (The Guardian).
